title: Agnes Sorel
autoCompleteNotReady: Available once the stock is empty and all cards are face up
stalemate: No moves left. Undo a move or give up.

frontendHint.moveToFoundation: A card can be moved to the foundation
frontendHint.moveToTableau: A card can be moved between tableau columns

tutorial.foundation: Build up cards from the base rank by suit here, wrapping King to Ace.
tutorial.stock: Click Deal to deal one face-up card to each tableau column.
tutorial.tableau: Tableau columns. Move the end card onto a same-color card one rank higher.
tutorial.actionButtons: Action buttons: deal, hint, undo, give up.
